prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop app composition for Byori, a native macOS multi-agent coding workspace
Primary request: Create COMPOSITION A, a balanced navigator-led first viewport for a real native macOS SwiftUI app. The largest organizing unit is a project. The hierarchy is Project → Source Tree or Worktree → Task → Session. A session has exactly one user-chosen coding agent and model, fixed for that session. This is not an automatic agent fan-out dashboard.
Scene/backdrop: a single macOS app window shown straight-on, edge to edge, no desk, no browser, no device mockup
Subject: a three-column Byori workspace. Left: a 260px project navigator with the project "byori" expanded, source tree "main", task "Build workspace", and selected session "Codex · gpt-5.6"; a subtle plus action for new session; Settings gear anchored at the bottom. Center: the dominant real interactive terminal surface with one selected session, a compact breadcrumb, live shell prompt and a few plausible short development commands. Right: a 300px inspector with tabs "Files", "Git", and "Context"; Context is active and shows a restrained ByoriDB section with small cards for "Decision", "Module", and "Task checkpoint".
Style/medium: polished high-fidelity native macOS SwiftUI product UI; standard title bar and traffic lights; system typography; SF Symbols-like iconography; restrained separators, materials, and native controls; no custom brand illustration
Composition/framing: 16:10 landscape, one full application viewport, balanced 260px navigator / flexible terminal / 300px inspector; terminal is visually dominant
Lighting/mood: neutral light appearance with a dark terminal canvas; calm, precise, operational
Color palette: macOS neutrals, near-black terminal, white and soft gray chrome, one restrained teal status accent
Text (verbatim): "Byori", "Projects", "byori", "main", "Build workspace", "Codex · gpt-5.6", "New Session", "Files", "Git", "Context", "ByoriDB", "Decision", "Module", "Task checkpoint", "Settings"
Constraints: show one active terminal only; make project hierarchy immediately legible; agent/model is metadata of the selected session, not a global mode; keep settings out of primary navigation; all core text must be readable; no fake metrics, testimonials, chat bubbles, graphs, or marketing copy
Avoid: automatic fan-out controls, multi-agent comparison panes, multiple simultaneous terminals, card-grid dashboard, web-app styling, oversized rounded cards, gradients, purple neon, copied Orca or Paseo branding, browser chrome, watermarks
